name: l0_sound_script_resolve
about: Sound-script resolution (walks/L0-r008.md): CSoundEmitterSystemBase::GetParametersForSound FUN_101b33f0 (0x101b33f0), the call every EmitSound / StopSound worker makes (0x101b0dc0, 0x101b1040, 0x101b1120, 0x101b14d0, 0x101b1880, 0x101b1a00, 0x101b06a0, 0x101b1dd0, 0x101b40a0, 0x101b4170), on a staged CSoundEmitterSystemBase table. Arms in retail order: FindSound FUN_101b2f60 (0x101b2f60) interns the name case-insensitively (strcmpi, 0x101b2f8c) and walks the symbol-ordered tree (0x101b2f97); -1 -> `No such sound %s`, false, out untouched (0x101b342b). Then channel (0x101b3447); volume = interval(rec+4) by FUN_1012f700 (0x1012f700: span 0.0f -> the base with no draw, else base + RandomFloat(0, span), one generator call, x in [0, 0.99999988]); pitch = trunc(interval) (0x101b3455); pitch_low = trunc(base), pitch_high = trunc(low + span) (0x101b3465-0x101b347f); count and an empty name (0x101b3482); the wave pick FUN_101b3240 (0x101b3240) for category 0: the entries whose category matches (0x101b3289) -> RandomInt(0, m-1) (0x101b32d0); none -> RandomInt(0, count-1) over every entry (0x101b3330); an empty list -> -1; a candidate set of ONE draws nothing (RandomInt(0, 0) returns without a generator call); soundlevel = trunc(interval) sampled even with no wave (0x101b34e4); play_to_owner_only (0x101b34f6); an empty name -> `sound %s has no wave or rndwave key!`, false (0x101b3516); rec+0x48 == 0 -> true with no validation (0x101b3528); a `!` name -> true (0x101b3532); up to two sound chars of `*?!#@><^)` stripped, `sound/%s` asked of VFileSystem005 slot 9 (0x101b3599), present -> true; absent -> the case-sensitive cache DAT_1072c078 keyed `<sound>:<wave as stored>` (0x101b3601): a miss adds the key and prints `sound '%s' references wave '%s' which doesn't exist on disk!` (0x101b361c, 0x101b3628), a hit is silent; false either way (0x101b3631). rec+0x48 is written by the BaseInit pass FUN_101b4740 (0x101b4740): every wave of every record, `!` names skipped, the same strip, a miss sets the flag. Draw order volume -> pitch -> pick -> soundlevel: 4 generator calls with three non-zero spans and two or more candidates, 3 with one. Reported as `fail` when an arm, a value, a draw count or a message differs from retail's.

notes: The pick's distribution is not asserted (the vstdlib stream's seeding is UNRECOVERED; the port draws from the session's named SoundScript stream): a record asserts the candidate set, the arm and the draw count, and reads the result through a character class. A 110 for Ranged.Pitch would need the x87 sum to round up to float before __ftol (precision control UNRECOVERED); the class accepts it. The `names` probe shows the unknown name Nope.Sound interned by FindSound (13 = 12 + 1); the NULL name interns nothing. The U table models records before the BaseInit pass (flag 0 whatever the files), which is also how a sound AddSound 0x101b4d30 copies without a flag plays.
